plan.notes: Official 4-year plan of study published in the Sam Houston State University 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (catalog.shsu.edu). Courses, credits, and semester placement transcribed verbatim from the catalog plan grid; catalog footnotes preserved as choice notes. Credit ranges resolved to the minimum (catalog totals are ranges).

courses.title: Composition I
courses.choice_note: Satisfies the Core Curriculum requirement for Component Area I (Communication).

courses.title: Weather and Climate
courses.choice_note: GEOG 1401 satisfies four credit hours of the Core Curriculum requirement for Component Area III (Life and Physical Science) OR the Degree Specific Requirements for Life and Physical Science. Students who choose to apply this course towards the Geography major may also need to complete additional coursework in order to fulfill the 120 credit hour requirement.

courses.title: People, Places, and the Environment
courses.choice_note: Introductory Geography Courses: GEOG 1300 also satisfies the Core Curriculum requirement for Component Area VIII (Social and Behavioral Sciences) while GEOG 2355 or GEOG 2356 satisfies the Core Curriculum requirement for Component Area IV (Language, Philosophy, and Culture). Students who choose to also apply these courses towards the Geography major may need to complete additional coursework in order to fulfill the 120 credit hour requirement for graduation.
